claims.sentence: The payment for order ord_0903 was successfully captured (payments:pay_0903) and the order marked paid (orders:ord_0903).

However, the grant batch timed out after the first grant row was written (server_logs:2026-10-17T01:01:10Z@/api/payments/confirm), and a manual retry created a second grant for the same email and reward (grants:g_ord_0903_retry), resulting in the customer receiving 60 credits twice.
